lessons.canonical_key: compare downstream predictions with and without predicted feature imputations instead of judging the imputation model alone. | a missing feature can itself be modeled accurately | predictive_quality
lessons.title: Check predictive imputations for downstream benefit
lessons.statement: When a missing feature can itself be modeled accurately, proposed reuse: Proposed conditional application: Compare downstream predictions with and without predicted feature imputations instead of judging the imputation model alone. Proposed check: Fit imputers within folds; compare downstream model with/without imputed features and missingness flags. Limitation: Predictable imputation does not add independent target information; 0.78x is not exact numeric evidence.
